AuthorizeEndpointAcl.description_en: Adds one or more Access Control List (ACL) rules to an endpoint of a specified type
AuthorizeEndpointAcl.description_zh: 本接口用于新增指定类型的接入点的一条或多条Acl规则

CreateQueue.description_zh: 调用CreateQueue接口创建一个新的队列

CreateTopic.description_en: Calls the CreateTopic operation to create a topic

DeleteQueue.description_en: Calls the DeleteQueue operation to delete a created queue
DeleteQueue.description_zh: 调用DeleteQueue接口删除已创建的队列

DeleteTopic.description_en: Calls the DeleteTopic operation to delete a topic

DisableEndpoint.description_en: This operation disables an endpoint of a specified type, blocking all subsequent requests from the endpoint and returning an error
DisableEndpoint.description_zh: 本接口用于关闭指定类型接入点。关闭后，所有源自对应接入点的请求都将被拦截并返回错误

EnableEndpoint.description_en: This operation enables an endpoint of a specified type. After the endpoint is enabled, requests that originate from the endpoint and are on the Access Control List (ACL) whitelist are not blocked
EnableEndpoint.description_zh: 本接口用于启用指定类型的接入点。开启后，源自对应接入点且处于Acl白名单中的请求都将不会被拦截

GetAccountAttributes.description_en: Retrieves the log configuration of a user

GetEndpointAttribute.description_en: Queries the attributes of an endpoint

GetQueueAttributes.description_en: Retrieves the attributes of a created queue
GetQueueAttributes.description_zh: 获取某个已创建队列的属性

GetSubscriptionAttributes.description_en: Retrieves the properties of a subscription

GetTopicAttributes.description_en: Queries the attributes of a topic
GetTopicAttributes.description_zh: 调用GetTopicAttributes接口获取主题的属性

ListEventRules.description_en: Queries a list of event notification rules

ListQueue.description_en: Lists all queues under a specified Alibaba Cloud account with pagination support
ListQueue.description_zh: 调用ListQueue接口，列出指定阿里云账号下的所有队列，可分页获取数据

ListSubscriptionByTopic.description_en: You can call the ListSubscriptionByTopic operation to retrieve a paginated list of subscriptions for a topic
ListSubscriptionByTopic.description_zh: 调用ListSubscriptionByTopic接口列出某个主题下的Subscription列表，可分页获取数据

ListTopic.description_en: Queries the list of topics under an Alibaba Cloud account with paginated results
ListTopic.description_zh: 调用ListTopic接口查询阿里云账号下的主题列表，可分页获取数据

RevokeEndpointAcl.description_en: Revokes one or more Access Control List (ACL) rules for a specified endpoint type
RevokeEndpointAcl.description_zh: 本接口用于删除指定类型的接入点的一条或多条Acl规则

SetQueueAttributes.description_en: Calls the SetQueueAttributes operation to modify queue attributes
SetQueueAttributes.description_zh: 调用SetQueueAttributes接口修改队列属性

SetSubscriptionAttributes.description_en: Call the SetSubscriptionAttributes operation to modify a subscription's attributes

SetTopicAttributes.description_en: Calls the SetTopicAttributes operation to modify the attributes of a topic
SetTopicAttributes.description_zh: 调用SetTopicAttributes接口来修改主题的属性

Subscribe.description_en: Calls the Subscribe operation to create a subscription for a topic

Unsubscribe.description_en: You can call Unsubscribe to cancel an existing subscription
Unsubscribe.description_zh: 调用Unsubscribe接口取消一个已创建的Subscription
